name: anolex_grbl_esp32
description: The Grbl_ESP32 controller in an AnoleX 4060-Evo Ultra 2's control box: an ESP32 behind a CH340 USB bridge on a 100 x 80 mm board, the size assumed since the maker publishes no drawing -- the node a router's serial port is pinned to.

source.title: anolex_grbl_esp32, assumed
source.author: Quaternion Media
source.note: Built in OpenSCAD; the maker publishes no drawing of the board, so its size and layout are assumed and README.md says which. No mesh of anyone's was used.
